g.text: Copilot, automation, agent: one dial, three postures
more AI action alone: more value, more risk, more evals
autonomy rises from left to right
who: AI runs one bounded step
who: AI plans and executes steps
decision rule: start at the lowest autonomy that works
earn the right: log accept and edit rates, widen scope
approval gates on every irreversible step (payments, emails)
analogy: Waymo runs driverless robotaxis in limited areas
moving right: from acceptance and edit rate to task success
